task_description: Complete visual transformation of the Madarek educational platform to match a Google Stitch design reference. Rebuild the design system (tokens, colors, typography, spacing, shadows, motion), redesign all shared components (sidebar, topbar, cards, buttons), and transform key pages (homepage, dashboards, learning paths) to achieve Samsung/Apple/Stripe-level premium quality.

verification.summary: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no npm install possible. Validated via: (1) CSS brace-balance verified across all 17 CSS files - all pass, (2) TSX component exports verified unchanged, (3) prefers-reduced-motion queries present in all animation files, (4) RTL logical properties used consistently (no directional left/right in new code), (5) No duplicate/conflicting token definitions. Review fixes applied: --fs-base aligned to 15px with body rule using token, will-change scoped to .in-view only, bottom-nav uses inset-inline, --danger-soft uses transparent wash in both themes.
